title: Transport of a normalized scalar pullback comparison to normalized section endpoints
statement: Given a coefficient map φ, a scheme morphism h:U→V, normalized section scalar comparisons sU and sV at its endpoints, and an internal scalar/pullback comparison b satisfying PullNormalized, the supplied b satisfies SectionPullNormalized relative to sU and sV. All operations and normalization equations are those of [def-sfb-internal-derived-scalar-comparisons] and [def-sfb-internal-section-scalar-pullback-comparison-data]. No flatness or boundedness is assumed.

source.place: Tags 03EK, 0D6D and 07A6; internal scalar/pullback normalization proof step 8, endpoint independence

proof.text: Transport the proved internal restriction/pushforward isomorphism through the canonical section scalar-restriction and geometric lower-comparison isomorphisms. Precomposition by the section equivalence is fully faithful, so take its unique preimage r. The component equations for the internal isomorphism and geometric comparisons, together with the canonical scalar comparison, prove that r is identity on sections, first on the essential image and then on all modules by naturality with the equivalence counit. Construct c as the inverse image of r under conjugateIsoEquiv of the composite ordinary adjunctions; apply_symm_apply proves its required conjugate equation.

Whisker the supplied b with the endpoint and geometric derived comparison isomorphisms. This is an isomorphism after precomposition by the section derived equivalence. Take its unique fully faithful preimage d. map_preimage, evaluation at M, and cancellation of the endpoint isomorphisms prove the realization equation for every M.

Apply the representative computation lemma to these explicitly constructed r,c,d, their identity/conjugate/realization equations, endpoint normalization, and PullNormalized. Package the witnesses and equations to obtain SectionPullNormalized.

proof_origin.place: Transport the internal ordinary comparison and the supplied derived comparison through the section equivalences; leave only the representative computation to the named strict substep.

theorem section_pull_normalized_of_normalized (φ : Λ ⟶ Λ') [IsMonHom φ]
    {U V : Scheme.{u}} (h : U ⟶ V)
    (sU : SectionScalarComparison φ U) (sV : SectionScalarComparison φ V)
    (hU : SectionScalarNormalized φ U sU) (hV : SectionScalarNormalized φ V sV)
    (b : D φ V ⋙ L Λ' h ≅ L Λ h ⋙ D φ U)
    (normalized : PullNormalized φ h b) :
    SectionPullNormalized φ h sU sV b
